fibo_definition: corporation whose shares are traded and held publicly
note: Opendoor Technologies Inc. and every public peer/partner/lender.

fibo_definition: formal organization that is a legal entity (artificial person) distinct from its owners
note: Superclass for private counterparties and subsidiaries (EX-21.1).

fibo_definition: credit agreement that allows the borrower to periodically take out money over an extended period of time rather than reapplying for a loan every time they need funds
note: Matches Opendoor's asset-backed revolving/term facilities exactly.

fibo_definition: credit facility that enables the borrower to withdraw funds, repay, and withdraw again
note: 'senior revolving credit facilities' in the non-GAAP definitions.

fibo_definition: upper bound on the total amount of money that a lender believes a party has the ability to repay an obligation when due, as of some point in time
note: Opendoor reports committed vs uncommitted capacity per facility; FIBO frames capacity as a lender's belief about the borrower, not a per-facility contractual limit. Prefer hasCreditLimit for the contractual number.

fibo_definition: a party that extends credit or money to a borrower with the expectation of being repaid, usually with interest
note: Time-bound ROLE, not an entity type. Credit Suisse/Goldman/Barclays are Companies playing Lender in a facility.

fibo_definition: party to a credit agreement that is obligated to repay the amount borrowed (principal) with interest and other fees
something pledged as security to ensure fulfillment of an obligation
note: Homes in inventory are pledged; drawdowns are per-home.

fibo_definition: share that signifies a unit of ownership in a corporation and represents a claim on part of the corporation's assets and earnings
share that is listed on at least one platform
note: Nasdaq listing; relevant to the Item 3.01 listing-compliance events.
No Warrant class in SEC/Equities/EquityInstruments.rdf. OPENW/OPENZ and the marketing warrants need a local class or a different FIBO module; do NOT invent a URI.

fibo_definition: statistical measure of economic activity that is regular and comparable in the context of a statistical area (region), used for analysis of economic performance and predictions of future performance
fit: direct for macro / UNSUITABLE for company KPIs
note: Good for mortgage rate, HPA, housing turnover. MUST NOT be used for Homes Sold or Contribution Margin: those are company operating measures, not regional economic activity.

fibo_definition: specifies a quantity value for a given indicator
note: Reuse the shape, not the property, for company KPI observations.

fibo_definition: hasBaselinePopulation: specifies the starting point statistical universe or population used for comparison; hasComparisonPopulation: specifies the subset used for comparison
note: Exactly the shape needed for the 120-day metric: baseline = Opendoor portfolio, comparison = MLS market adjusted for buybox. Adopt the PATTERN locally.

fibo_definition: contractual agreement in which a debtor receives something of value and typically agrees to repay the creditor
note: Only credit agreements. Partnership/offer-letter EX-10s need FND Arrangements (not yet inspected) or a local class.
FIBO does not model iBuyer operating KPIs. These require custom Opendoor/real-estate-marketplace definitions. Do not force-map.
